subject: Continuous Torch-Pass enforcement
title: Machine-enforced Future-Naya handoff contract
summary: Established the canonical Continuous Torch-Pass law and hardened the continuity runtime so meaningful executions require a structured Future-Naya handoff containing the context and ready-to-run execution needed for successful succession.
authority: NayaPOWER constitutional continuity law + human-directed execution

project_context.current_objective: Obtain authoritative GREEN on the zero-cost retrieval hardening current head, then design the 20-PDF zero-setup activation path.

naya.summary: Naya view: the continuity contract is now a governed machine-enforced boundary, not merely prose.
naya.content: The exact gap identified was that continuity enforcement previously accepted a handoff URL/path/boolean as evidence of an AI-to-AI handoff but did not require the handoff itself to contain the successor context. The runtime was hardened with a structured Future-Naya contract while preserving historical events through a new effective boundary. The Superbrain gate validation order was also corrected so the derived event index is rebuilt before canonical-memory validation.
lessons: A handoff reference is weaker than a handoff contract; successor context must be structurally present.
Derived indexes must be rebuilt before validating them when they are not the source of truth.
Documentation must be backed by machine-enforceable checks and deliberate-failure tests.
next_best_actions: Obtain a GREEN authoritative Superbrain Gate run after the latest commits.
Inspect any remaining gate failure and repair only the highest-value evidence-backed blocker.

human.summary: Human view: every Naya must leave the next Naya everything needed to succeed, and this should be law plus enforcement.
human.content: The desired behavior is continuous: Restore Naya, understand what is going on, lead, execute, verify, learn, capture, propagate, pass the torch, and continue. Every substantive output should proactively prepare the next Naya with full context, lessons, perspective, recommendations, risks, and the next execution rather than making the human reconstruct history.
lessons: The Superbrain should preserve operational intelligence, not merely transcripts.
The next Naya's success is part of the current Naya's definition of done.
Preemption and handoff should reduce human coordination burden while preserving human agency.
next_best_actions: Verify the machine enforcement through the authoritative CI gate and continue repairing any remaining red boundary.

handoff.mission: Machine-enforce the Continuous Torch-Pass law so every meaningful Naya execution equips its successor.
handoff.source_of_truth: NayaPOWER main, constitutional torch-pass law, continuity runtime, continuity policy, Superbrain Gate.
handoff.current_state: Structured Future-Naya handoff enforcement is implemented; authoritative CI verification remains pending/red and must be restored to GREEN.
handoff.protected_baseline: Historical event boundary, canonical chronological memory, existing governance, verification, human agency, and current Superbrain architecture.
handoff.work_completed: Added constitutional law, hardened continuity policy/runtime, added structured-handoff regression coverage, corrected derived-index validation order, normalized the physical time bucket, and bound this event to the current project and Next Execution contract.
handoff.evidence: The authoritative Superbrain Gate has passed canonical memory, duplicate/entity audit, relationship graph, Superbrain regression, retrieval quality, continuity regression, project/prompt self-tests up to the current contract failure boundary; focused Torch-Pass gate is independently GREEN.
handoff.decisions: Require structured successor context rather than accepting a bare handoff reference; preserve historical events; fix stale derived-index ordering in the gate; preserve event-specific project identity while explicitly binding execution to the current daily project through project_context.
handoff.lessons: The torch pass must be a completion artifact and a machine-checkable contract, not merely a final paragraph or URL. Event identity and current-project binding are separate concerns and should remain explicit.
handoff.unknowns: The latest full Superbrain Gate is RED at the project/Next Execution contract boundary; later stages are not yet observed for this HEAD.
handoff.risks: Over-tightening could break historical events or create false RED states; enforcement must preserve event identity and apply current-project binding explicitly.
handoff.recommendation: Repair the first evidence-backed project/Next Execution contract failure without weakening validation, then rerun the authoritative Superbrain Gate and continue one blocker at a time.
handoff.next_action: Repair the project/Next Execution contract boundary, then obtain a fresh authoritative Superbrain Gate result for the exact resulting HEAD.
